questions.stem_text: You cool a blackbody to half its original temperature. How does its spectrum change?

options.A: Power emitted is 1/16 times as high; peak emission wavelength is 1/2 as long.
options.B: Power emitted is 1/4 times as high; peak emission wavelength is 2 times longer.
options.C: Power emitted is 1/4 times as high; peak emission wavelength is 1/2 as long.
options.D: Power emitted is 1/16 times as high; peak emission wavelength is 2 times longer.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Power emitted is 1/16 times as high; peak emission wavelength is 2 times longer.

questions.stem_text: Our current best observations show that Pluto has

options.A: one medium sized satellite and two small satellites.
options.C: one large satellite and three small satellites.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - one medium sized satellite and two small satellites.

questions.stem_text:
Mars has an atmosphere that is almost entirely carbon dioxide.Why isn't there a strong
greenhouse effect keeping the planet warm?

options.A: Mars does not have enough internal heat to drive the greenhouse effect
options.B: Mars is too far from the sun for the greenhouse effect to work
options.C: the greenhouse effect requires an ozone layer which Mars does not have
options.D: the atmosphere on Mars is too thin to trap a significant amount of heat

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - the atmosphere on Mars is too thin to trap a significant amount of heat

questions.stem_text: The famous Drake equation attempts to answer the following question:

options.A: Will the Sun become a black hole?
options.C: How old is the visible universe?
options.D: Are we alone in the universe?

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Are we alone in the universe?
